question: What was the profession of Hazrat Abu Bakar (RA) before the Khilafat?
why: A) Cloth merchant is right. Hazrat Abu Bakar (RA) was a cloth merchant. B) Farmer is wrong: he was a trader, not a farmer. C) Blacksmith is wrong: he did not work as a blacksmith. D) Shepherd is wrong: he was a merchant, not a shepherd.
rel: Hazrat Abu Bakar (RA) was the first Khalifa (11 AH).

question: Which companion was born inside the Khana Kaaba?
why: A) Hazrat Ali (RA) is right. Hazrat Ali (RA) was born inside the Khana Kaaba. B) Hazrat Abu Bakar (RA) is wrong: he was not born in the Kaaba. C) Hazrat Umar (RA) is wrong: he was not born in the Kaaba. D) Hazrat Usman (RA) is wrong: he was not born in the Kaaba.
rel: Hazrat Ali (RA) killed Marhab in Khaibar.

question: How many doors does Jannat (Heaven) have?
why: A) 8 is right. Jannat has 8 doors, while Jahannam (Hell) has 7 doors. B) 7 is wrong: this is the number of doors of Hell. C) 6 is wrong: this is not the number. D) 10 is wrong: this is not the number.
rel: Hell has 7 doors.

question: How many doors does Jahannam (Hell) have according to the Quran?
why: D) 7 is right. Jahannam has 7 doors (Surah Al-Hijr). A) 8 is wrong: this is the number of doors of Jannat. B) 5 is wrong: this is not the number. C) 9 is wrong: this is not the number.
rel: Jannat has 8 doors.

question: Who killed Abu Jahl in Ghazwa Badr?
why: A) Hazrat Muaz (RA) and Hazrat Muawwaz (RA) is right. Two young brothers, Hazrat Muaz (RA) and Hazrat Muawwaz (RA), killed Abu Jahl at Badr. B) Hazrat Ali (RA) is wrong: he killed Marhab at Khaibar. C) Hazrat Hamza (RA) is wrong: he was a hero of Badr but did not kill Abu Jahl. D) Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed (RA) is wrong: he was not a Muslim at the time of Badr.
rel: Badr was fought on 17th Ramadan 2 AH.

question: Which companion is known as Zul-Shahadatain (whose witness equals two)?
why: B) Hazrat Khuzaima bin Sabit (RA) is right. Hazrat Khuzaima bin Sabit (RA) is called Zul-Shahadatain. A) Hazrat Usman (RA) is wrong: he is called Zun-Noorain. C) Hazrat Abu Bakar (RA) is wrong: he is called Siddiq. D) Hazrat Umar (RA) is wrong: he is called Farooq.
rel: Hazrat Usman (RA) is Zun-Noorain (owner of two lights).

question: Cave Hira is located in which mountain?
why: A) Jabal-e-Noor is right. Cave Hira is in Jabal-e-Noor near Makkah. B) Jabal-e-Soor is wrong: it has Cave Soor. C) Mount Uhud is wrong: it is near Madina. D) Mount Judi is wrong: the Ark of Nooh (AS) rested there.
rel: The first revelation came in Cave Hira.

question: During the Hijrat, how many days did the Holy Prophet PBUH stay in Cave Soor?
why: D) 3 days is right. The Holy Prophet PBUH and Hazrat Abu Bakar (RA) stayed 3 days in Cave Soor. A) 7 days is wrong: this is not the correct period. B) 10 days is wrong: this is not the correct period. C) 1 day is wrong: they stayed longer than one day.
rel: Cave Hira is in Jabal-e-Noor.

question: The second migration to Habsha (Abyssinia) took place in:
why: C) 616 AD is right. The second migration to Habsha took place in 616 AD. A) 615 AD is wrong: this is the year of the first migration. B) 610 AD is wrong: this is the year of the first revelation. D) 622 AD is wrong: this is the year of Hijrat to Madina.
rel: Najashi, the Christian king of Habsha, gave them shelter.

question: Who killed Marhab the Jew in Ghazwa Khaibar?
why: B) Hazrat Ali (RA) is right. Hazrat Ali (RA) killed Marhab in Khaibar (7 AH). A) Hazrat Hamza (RA) is wrong: he was martyred at Uhud in 3 AH. C) Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed (RA) is wrong: he was not yet a Muslim in 7 AH. D) Hazrat Umar (RA) is wrong: he did not kill Marhab.
rel: Hazrat Ali (RA) was born in the Khana Kaaba.

question: Hazrat Abbas (RA) was the Holy Prophet's PBUH:
why: A) Uncle is right. Hazrat Abbas (RA) was the uncle of the Holy Prophet PBUH. B) Cousin is wrong: Hazrat Ali (RA) was a cousin. C) Grandfather is wrong: Abdul Muttalib was the grandfather. D) Son-in-law is wrong: Ali (RA) and Usman (RA) were sons-in-law.
rel: Hazrat Hamza (RA) was also an uncle of the Holy Prophet PBUH.

question: What was the religion of Najashi, the king of Habsha, before Islam?
why: D) Christianity is right. Najashi was a Christian king who gave shelter to the Muslims. A) Judaism is wrong: he was not a Jew. B) Fire worship (Majoosi) is wrong: that was the religion of Persia. C) Idol worship is wrong: that was the religion of the Quraish.
rel: The Muslims migrated to Habsha in 615 and 616 AD.

question: Masjid Qiblatain (mosque of two Qiblas) is located in:
why: C) Madina is right. Masjid Qiblatain is in Madina, where the order to change the Qibla came. A) Makkah is wrong: it is not in Makkah. B) Taif is wrong: it is not in Taif. D) Bait-ul-Muqaddas is wrong: that was the first Qibla, not this mosque.
rel: The Qibla was changed in 2 AH.

question: In Hajj, what is Istilam?
options: Touching or kissing the Black Stone
why: C) Touching or kissing the Black Stone is right. Istilam means touching or kissing the Hajr-e-Aswad (Black Stone). A) Stoning the devil is wrong: this is called Rami. B) Walking between Safa and Marwa is wrong: this is called Saee. D) Staying at Arafat is wrong: this is called Wuquf.
rel: Rami is stoning the devil.

question: In Hajj, stoning the devil (Shaitan) is called:
why: B) Rami is right. Stoning the devil is called Rami. A) Istilam is wrong: it is touching the Black Stone. C) Saee is wrong: it is walking between Safa and Marwa. D) Tawaf is wrong: it is going around the Kaaba.
rel: Istilam is touching the Black Stone.

question: How many rounds of Saee are made between Safa and Marwa?
why: A) 7 is right. Saee has 7 rounds between Safa and Marwa. B) 5 is wrong: this is not the number. C) 3 is wrong: this is not the number. D) 9 is wrong: this is not the number.
rel: Tawaf of the Kaaba also has 7 rounds.

question: Which land is known as the Land of Prophets?
why: B) Palestine is right. Palestine (Sham region) is called the Land of Prophets. A) Egypt is wrong: it is not given this title. C) Iraq is wrong: it is not given this title. D) Yemen is wrong: it is not given this title.
rel: Bait-ul-Muqaddas, the first Qibla, is in Palestine.

question: How many years did the Holy Prophet PBUH live in Madina after the Hijrat?
why: C) 10 years is right. The Holy Prophet PBUH lived 10 years in Madina (1 AH to 11 AH). A) 13 years is wrong: this is the time spent preaching in Makkah. B) 8 years is wrong: this is too short. D) 23 years is wrong: this is the whole period of Prophethood.
rel: He preached 13 years in Makkah.

question: What is the plural of Hadith?
why: A) Ahadith is right. The plural of Hadith is Ahadith. B) Hadisaat is wrong: this is not the plural. C) Muhaddis is wrong: this means a scholar of Hadith. D) Tahdees is wrong: this is not the plural.
rel: The first book of Hadith is Muwatta Imam Malik.

question: Which is the first compiled book of Hadith?
why: A) Muwatta Imam Malik is right. Muwatta Imam Malik is the first compiled book of Hadith. B) Sahih Bukhari is wrong: it was compiled later by Imam Bukhari. C) Sahih Muslim is wrong: it was compiled later by Imam Muslim. D) Sunan Abu Dawood is wrong: it was compiled later.
rel: Sahih Bukhari is the most authentic book of Hadith.

question: The first Ashra (ten days) of Ramadan is the Ashra of:
why: D) Rehmat (mercy) is right. The first Ashra of Ramadan is Rehmat (mercy). A) Maghfirat (forgiveness) is wrong: it is the second Ashra. B) Nijat (freedom from Hell) is wrong: it is the third Ashra. C) Barakat (blessing) is wrong: it is not the name of an Ashra.
rel: Second Ashra: Maghfirat; third Ashra: Nijat.

question: The third Ashra (last ten days) of Ramadan is the Ashra of:
why: A) Nijat (freedom from Hell) is right. The third Ashra of Ramadan is Nijat (freedom from Hell). B) Rehmat (mercy) is wrong: it is the first Ashra. C) Maghfirat (forgiveness) is wrong: it is the second Ashra. D) Sabr (patience) is wrong: it is not the name of an Ashra.
rel: First Ashra: Rehmat; second Ashra: Maghfirat.

question: What was the real name of Iblees?
why: D) Azazeel is right. The real name of Iblees was Azazeel. A) Haroot is wrong: Haroot and Maroot were two angels in Babylon. B) Qabeel is wrong: he was a son of Adam (AS). C) Samri is wrong: he made the calf in the time of Moosa (AS).
rel: Iblees was called the teacher of the angels before he disobeyed.

question: Iblees, before he disobeyed Allah, was known as the:
why: B) Teacher of the angels is right. Iblees (Azazeel) was known as the teacher of the angels. A) King of the jinn is wrong: he was not given this title. C) Guard of Jannat is wrong: the guard of Jannat is Rizwan. D) Guard of Jahannam is wrong: the guard of Jahannam is Malik.
rel: His real name was Azazeel.

question: To which prophet were 30 Sahifas given?
why: A) Hazrat Idrees (AS) is right. Hazrat Idrees (AS) was given 30 Sahifas. B) Hazrat Sheeth (AS) is wrong: he was given 50 Sahifas. C) Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) is wrong: he was given 10 Sahifas. D) Hazrat Adam (AS) is wrong: he was given 10 Sahifas.
rel: In total 100 Sahifas and 4 books were revealed.
note: The notes say '30 Sahifas' as a total; corrected: 100 Sahifas in total, 30 to Idrees (AS).

question: How many Sahifas were revealed in total?
why: D) 100 is right. In total 100 Sahifas were revealed: Sheeth 50, Idrees 30, Ibrahim 10, Adam 10. A) 30 is wrong: this is the number given to Idrees (AS). B) 50 is wrong: this is the number given to Sheeth (AS). C) 4 is wrong: this is the number of big heavenly books.
rel: Along with the Sahifas, 4 big books were revealed.
note: Corrected from the notes, which say 30 Sahifas.

question: How many major heavenly books were revealed?
why: D) 4 is right. Four major books were revealed: Taurat, Zaboor, Injeel and the Quran. A) 3 is wrong: one book would be missing. B) 5 is wrong: there are only four. C) 100 is wrong: this is the number of Sahifas.
rel: 100 Sahifas were also revealed.

question: Which was the first mosque (house of worship) in the world?
why: B) Khana Kaaba is right. Khana Kaaba was the first house of worship in the world. A) Masjid-e-Nabvi is wrong: it was built in 1 AH in Madina. C) Masjid-e-Aqsa is wrong: it was built after the Kaaba. D) Masjid-e-Quba is wrong: it was the first mosque built by the Holy Prophet PBUH.
rel: Masjid-e-Quba is the first mosque of Islam built by the Holy Prophet PBUH.
